content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to [product_name] and have a basic question. I have a system set up with an [product_name] module connected to a PT100 sensor. I need to control a fan to turn on and off at two adjustable temperature thresholds, which I'd like to set using the [product_name] display. Additionally, I want to show the current temperature in both Celsius and Fahrenheit on the display. Any advice would be appreciated. Regards, [user_name]

Hi, You can use two analog amplifiers after a single analog input, with both set to PT100 input—one for Celsius, the other for Fahrenheit. Both values can be displayed. To control the fan output, use an analog threshold trigger; the on/off values can be shown and modified directly on your display. Regards,
